title: Stony VDFS Sidecar Record v1
description: Forward-looking JSON Schema for the sidecar records that the stony-vdfs-index pipeline will persist alongside indexed media files. v1 is published in advance of the M6 milestone so that downstream tooling can target a stable shape from the v0.1.0-alpha.1 release onward. The corresponding in-memory Rust type lives in `crates/stony-vdfs-index/src/sidecar.rs`.

schema_version.description: Schema version constant. v1 records always carry the literal string "1".

path.description: VFS-absolute path of the file this record describes, normalized to forward slashes.

extracted_with.description: Identifier of the transcriber+tagger backends used to produce the record. Convention: `<transcriber_name>@<version>+<tagger_name>@<version>` (for example, `whisper.cpp@v1.5.4+llama3-1b@q4`). Free-form string so backends may include build metadata, model hashes, or quantization markers.

extracted_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp of when the indexing run finished. Must include a timezone offset (`Z` for UTC).

confidence.description: Optional aggregate confidence of the transcriber across the audio (0 = no confidence, 1 = full confidence). Semantics are transcriber-defined; this field exists so callers can filter low-quality records without parsing model-specific signals.

MediaInfo.description: FFmpeg probe output for the source file.

container.description: Container format reported by FFmpeg (mp4, mkv, mp3, wav, etc.).

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the media file in seconds, if known. Absent for streams of unknown length.

audio_codec.description: Codec name of the primary audio stream (aac, opus, mp3, …) or null if there is no audio track.

audio_sample_rate.description: Sample rate of the primary audio stream in Hz, or null if unknown / absent.

audio_channels.description: Number of audio channels in the primary audio stream, or null if unknown / absent.

video_codec.description: Codec name of the primary video stream (h264, hevc, av1, …) or null if there is no video track.

Transcript.description: Whisper-style transcript with optional segment timestamps.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code detected by the transcriber, or null if unknown.

text.description: Full transcript text. May be empty if the audio was silent.

segments.description: Optional segment timestamps. Empty array allowed for transcribers that do not produce them.

TranscriptSegment.description: One timestamped segment of a transcript.

start_seconds.description: Start of the segment in seconds from the beginning of the audio.

end_seconds.description: End of the segment in seconds from the beginning of the audio. Must be >= start_seconds.

TagSet.description: Tags produced by the local-LLM tagger.

tags.description: Semantic tags inferred from the transcript or other text content.

summary.description: One-sentence summary, if the tagger produces one. Null otherwise.

ModelProvenance.description: Optional structured record of which exact model produced the transcript/tags. Useful when `extracted_with` is not granular enough — for instance, when reproducing or auditing results.

model_hash.description: Optional cryptographic hash of the model file (hex-encoded SHA-256 by convention).

temperature.description: Optional sampling temperature used for the inference run.

transcript.text: Welcome to the pilot episode. Today we are going to talk about virtual filesystems.

segments.text: Today we are going to talk about virtual filesystems.

tags.summary: Pilot episode introducing the show's focus on virtual filesystems.
